shots.content: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other. A woman in a forest-green blouse sits in the plant-side window seat recounting an anecdote, a man in a navy-blue cardigan sits in the counter-side window seat, and a woman in a burgundy sweater sits in the plant-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide view from the aisle-side corner, looking diagonally across the rectangular table. The full table and all three seats are visible.

shots.content: The man in a navy-blue cardigan asks the woman in a forest-green blouse what happened next.
shots.viewpoint: Medium close view of the two people in the window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a forest-green blouse answers the man in a navy-blue cardigan with the conclusion.
shots.viewpoint: Wide view from the counter end, looking along the full table toward the floor plant. Both window-side seats and the plant-end seat are visible.
